title: Concept: pnpm override replaces a transitive range with a wildcard
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares an override that forces a transitive dependency to accept any version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every transitive consumer of the package resolves to whatever the registry publishes next, outside the top-level review entirely.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: Every transitive consumer of the package resolves to whatever the registry publishes next, outside the top-level review entirely.
